replacements.Cuándo accede el modelo a la imagen: When the model can access the image
replacements.La diferencia clave entre encoder-conect: The key difference between encoder-connector and cross-attention is not the architecture itself but when visual evidence remains accessible: one processes the image once before generation; the other queries it at every relevant layer throughout generation.
replacements.Pre-generación — la imagen se procesa un: Pre-generation — the image is processed once
replacements.Durante la generación — todos los tokens: During generation — every token reads the same blob
replacements.el modelo no puede volver a la imagen or: the model cannot return to the original image
replacements.Si el modelo necesita verificar un detal: If the model needs to verify a spatial detail during generation, it cannot. All available visual information was already captured in the fixed blob before the first generated token.
replacements.Pre-procesamiento — imagen codificada co: Pre-processing — image encoded as an accessible pool
replacements.Durante la generación — cada capa de cro: During generation — every cross-attention layer queries the pool
replacements.consultado dinámicamente en cada capa de: queried dynamically at every cross-attention layer
replacements.El modelo accede al detalle visual relev: The model accesses the relevant visual detail exactly when it needs it, not only at the beginning
replacements.Las capas adicionales de cross-attention: Additional cross-attention layers increase per-token cost and make horizontal scaling harder
